description: This file defines the Result class in the AWS SDK for PHP, representing the result of an AWS API call, including data handling, searching with JMESPath, and string representation.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Represents the result of an AWS SDK API operation, providing data access, search, and string formatting functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Result object with optional data array.

methods.name: hasKey
methods.description: Checks if the specified key exists in the result data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the specified key.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a JMESPath search over the result data.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the result data in JSON format with descriptive text.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Deprecated method to perform a search based on a '/' delimited path.
